Describe.

message.content: MeanReversionBand is a mean-reversion strategy on the M30 timeframe that takes long entries when price touches the lower Bollinger Band, RSI falls below 35, and price is below VWAP. Positions are closed when price reverts to the middle Bollinger Band or RSI recovers above 50. Risk management caps each trade at 1.5% with stops placed below the lower band and a 3% daily loss limit.
